compiled_state.title: As a CI reviewer pipeline, I dispatch overlay agents (security/performance/test_quality) as parallel litellm calls
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: When the bash classifier flags security_overlay, performance_overlay, or test_quality_overlay, dispatch.py issues parallel litellm calls to the corresponding code-reviewer-*.md agent files. Outputs are merged into the review findings array under the same schema.
**Why**: CI parity (SC2): match local overlay dispatch behavior so PRs flagged for overlays in classifier get the same coverage in CI as locally.
**Scope**:
  IN:
  - dispatch.py reads classifier overlay flags and dispatches matching overlay agents in parallel
  - Overlay outputs validated under the same schema as tier outputs
  - Serial 'overlay_warranted' fallback path also implemented (tier reviewer can flag mid-review)
  OUT:
  - dispatch.py base loader (S1)
  - Deep-arch synthesis (S4)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, CI runs overlay reviewers in parallel when their flags are set, mirroring local /dso:review overlay dispatch
  ← Satisfies: "Single source of truth for review prompts (CI parity)"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Performance] Parallel litellm calls bound by orchestration.max_agents and CI runner concurrency limits

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
